page.overview:
Who is Beedle?

In , is a traveling merchant who peddles wares to sailors of the . Although his sales pitch is unmatched, misfortune seems to pursue him. During 's journey, he and Beedle sporadically cross paths. Beedle's wares range from and to for and , making his shop a great resource for resupplying. He also offers key items like the . Beedle's eccentric mannerisms and relatively affordable prices set him apart from other merchants. Additionally, Beedle mails items to Link such as , a tool to help locate him.

Beedle dreams of opening a chain of trading posts where people can buy, sell, or trade anything. He owns and operates many Shop Ships across the Great Sea, and will gladly buy anything Link happens to have in his Spoils Bag. Regular patrons are rewarded with Silver and Gold Memberships Beedle's name coincides with a great love for insects, particularly beetles.

At the , Beedle assumes an alter ego as his own . When first visits the shop, "" asserts that they've never met, refuses to buy , and denies being Beedle— despite the fact that he appears on . sells rarer, more expensive items: Empty Bottles, a Piece of Heart, and a Treasure Chart leading to another Piece of Heart.

After obtains the from and returns to , he can use the to clear off the dust covering one of the stalls in the square. Once the dust is cleared, and Link has both obtained the from the , and entered , will set up shop in the stall.
